authority.late_binding_rule: The containing P commit, tree, blob OID and full-byte SHA-256 are verified after this file is committed and are recorded in R; the five nulls here prevent self-reference.

purpose: Evaluate the unchanged reviewed C6 candidate family on the same 765/958 scenario manifests and formal gates. V9 Base L1 was cancelled at the 360-minute platform limit without any checkpoint or result artifact (run 33893437188); it remains incomplete_no_checkpoint and is not evidence for v10. The user explicitly authorized recovery and necessary recomputation. V10 changes only execution infrastructure: actual bounded child checkpoints, exact-prefix resume, R-derived producer identities, and trusted automatic handoff. No economic threshold, candidate policy, ordering, allocation, fee, input data, scenario, or gate is tuned from prior runs.

baseline_integrity_test_repair.scope: Remove only the mutable-checkout source-fingerprint assertion while preserving all frozen artifact, provenance, data, scenario, rejection and derivation checks.

baseline_compatibility.supersession_rule: The sealed 765-ID current cohort replaces the incompatible historical 281-ID cohort only as the runnable C6 manifest; historical files and conclusions remain immutable.

scenario_manifests.serialization: UTF-8; IDs in each manifest's explicitly documented order (lexicographic where stated, listed order otherwise); one ID per line; LF after every line including the last; SHA-256 over exact bytes

generation: For each variant in exact order [baseline,F0-only,F0+F1,U-only,C6-Base], emit `${variant}::${scenario_id}` for every L1_ECONOMIC_SCENARIO_IDS entry in its frozen lexicographic order.
Then emit W0-no-601869 through W5-full-base-production-pool-relative-no-lock, in numeric order, each paired only with add-one-13-601869.

L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST.generation: Emit `C6-Base+S::${scenario_id}` for every L1_ECONOMIC_SCENARIO_IDS entry in frozen lexicographic order.
L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST.base_counterpart_rule: For each exact C6-Base+S::<scenario_id> evaluation ID, the sole authorized Base counterpart is C6-Base::<the identical scenario_id> in the transitive sealed c6.base.l1 producer. Prefix replacement is byte-exact; lookup must return exactly one record or the payload is invalid.
L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST.synthetic_control_rule: The four S controls are fixture-only, have economic_fields=null and are never members of cross-producer no_effect_comparisons. Their exact assertions_by_control specs are self-contained contracts; s/no-op-control/v1 records s_effective_count=0 and recomputes equality of orders, fills, cash, positions and equity hashes inside the fixture before emitting its three non-economic assertions.

L1_INSTRUMENTATION_NO_DRIFT_SCENARIO_IDS.semantics: Run the selected stage candidate once with factual recording disabled and once enabled; compare the five canonical path hashes exactly. These pairs are additional nonpromotable checks and are not residual candidates.

EXECUTION_ITEM_MANIFESTS.serialization: UTF-8; exact listed/derived order; one item ID per line with a final LF; SHA-256 over exact bytes

c6.base.l1.derivation: In order: prefix every L1_BASE_EVALUATION_MANIFEST ID with evaluation/; prefix every L1_BASE_SYNTHETIC_CONTROL_IDS ID with control/; prefix every L1_INSTRUMENTATION_NO_DRIFT_SCENARIO_IDS ID with no-drift/.

c6.s.qualification.derivation: After exact Base producer validation, mechanically derive R_L1 from the 765 C6-Base evaluation records using S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.residual_formula, sort the complete residual IDs lexicographically, and prefix each with qualification/. Empty residuals prohibit this binding rather than producing an empty run. The resolved count/hash become binding-signature and checkpoint inputs before the first item executes.

c6.base_plus_s.l1.derivation: In order: prefix every L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST ID with evaluation/; prefix every L1_S_SYNTHETIC_CONTROL_IDS ID with control/; prefix every L1_INSTRUMENTATION_NO_DRIFT_SCENARIO_IDS ID with no-drift/. Cross-producer common-prefix and no-S-effect comparisons are payload-level validations over economic evaluations and are not additional economic evaluations; S controls remain fixture-only non-economic assertion records.

c6.selected.l2.derivation: Prefix every L2_EXACT_SCENARIO_IDS ID, in its listed frozen order, with scenario/.

c6.selected.l4.derivation: Prefix every canonical formal generator-order scenario ID with scenario/. This is not lexicographic order; it is exact stress_scenarios._multi_seed_scenarios generator order used by the official checkpoint.

candidates.economic_run_condition: Every mechanically derived Base L1 residual passes S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.

F0.evidence: consolidate_risk_sells globally keys independent states by only symbol and strategy_name
F0.winner_order: higher priority; then larger target_shares; then lexicographically smaller reason

F1.scope: same execution batch and same state/book/symbol/strategy as one retained defensive sell winner
F1.capture_time: Capture the unique retained risk-sell winner set before any sell in the current execution batch.
F1.effect: The captured winner vetoes same-state/book/symbol buys through the end of that batch, even if an ordinary sell clears the position or the risk sell is blocked/partial.
F1.lifetime: Current-batch capture is immutable. At the next batch, retain only a still-live pending winner under the frozen position, expiry/cancel, odd-lot/full-liquidation and target-satisfied rules.
F1.release: Perform terminal cleanup only after all sells and buys in the current batch. A cleanup decision affects the next batch, never releases a veto inside the current batch.
carry: limit or suspension blocked with live executable remainder
missing open or missing data defer with live executable remainder
ADV zero with live executable remainder
capacity partial fill with remainder at least one lot
remainder >= current_shares > 0 including odd-lot full liquidation
forbidden: ordinary sell promotion to risk veto
F1.no_op_predicate: The base implementation captures the exact retained overlay winner before sell execution and applies its same-book veto through the buy phase.

F2.static_reason: Current authoritative docs and call graph define retained overlay winners as per-book sells or weakest-symbol trims, not immutable portfolio-symbol or portfolio-cluster net targets. Global liquidation remains account-manager owned.

S.base_observational_evidence: I_B computes and serializes the complete S qualification evidence without scheduling or mutating any action; I_S reuses the same evidence calculation and adds only the frozen early concentration action when S_effective_formula is true.
S.evidence_active_formula: worst_cluster in complete_causal_stressed_cluster_set AND risk_level >= 1 AND portfolio_fast_return < 0 AND observed_count_freshness_coverage_pass AND concentration_unmapped_limit_pass AND leave_held_components_out_witness_pass
S.worst_cluster: largest actual merged-account held notional among eligible mapped clusters; exact notional tie breaks by ascending cluster label
S.stressed_cluster_set: all sub-baskets satisfying the existing fixed stress thresholds, deterministically sorted by label
S.leave_held_components_out: Remove every risk/subindustry basket component whose mapped cluster equals the target held cluster, recompute the same existing return, breadth, observation, freshness and coverage predicates, and require the same target cluster's independent evidence family to remain active; no overlap is a disjoint-pass.
S.lead_batch_definition: Count official calendar execution batches strictly after the first qualifying evidence decision close and no later than the first_official_mdd_breach valuation sample; the first scheduler-selected next-tradable-open batch is the only candidate action batch and may not be searched forward for a fill.
S.official_breach_formula: first official equity sample with abs(drawdown_from_official_running_peak) > 0.18 + 1e-15
S.v10_change_constraint: Reviewed v9 I_B/I_S economic decision blobs remain byte-identical. Result-independent checkpoint/resume execution, producer logical identity derivation, provenance and synthetic tests may change. The official stress runner budget repair is already in the pre-P baseline, remains frozen during implementation, and changes neither checkpoint schema nor economic computation. No response to v9 economic outcomes is authorized: none were sealed.

interventions_601869.delta_formula: For the production-path chain W0..W4, delta_i = V(W_i)-V(W_(i-1)) and sum(delta_i for i=1..4) must equal V(W4)-V(W0). Report the nested lock effect separately as V(W5)-V(W4); the four production deltas plus that conditional effect must equal V(W5)-V(W0), exactly under deterministic float serialization.
interventions_601869.reversed_order_sensitivity: Use the one frozen alternate admissible production-path order [W0,W1,W3,W2,W4], report its four per-step deltas and named-edge interaction residual versus [W0,W1,W2,W3,W4]. W5 remains only the separate nested no-lock contrast V(W5)-V(W4). This sensitivity cannot select a candidate.

S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.residual_formula: R_L1 is the lexicographically ordered set of C6-Base evaluation scenario IDs whose unrounded official_metrics.max_drawdown has abs(value) > 0.18 + 1e-15.

criteria.formula: Residual metric breaches and first_official_mdd_breach.timestamp is non-null.
Evidence close is non-null and strictly precedes the official breach timestamp.
worst_cluster is in the complete stressed set and worst_cluster_weight > frozen CONCENTRATION_CAP.
Every observed-count/freshness/coverage/unmapped gate and the leave-held-components-out witness passes.

risk_level >= 1, portfolio_fast_return < 0, existing_concentration_eligible is true, cluster_symbol_count >= minimum_cluster_size=2, early_sell_required is true while legacy_gate_open is false, and the frozen pre-breach scheduler batch has executable_lot_shares > 0.
Execution ordering is strictly earlier than the official breach sample and lead_batch_count >= 1; no later fill search.
official_sample_relation is not UNAVOIDABLE_AT_OFFICIAL_SAMPLE; OPEN_MARK_GAP_NOT_OFFICIAL_SAMPLE passes.

R_schema.runtime_binding_signature: SHA-256 over canonical_json_v2(runtime_binding_signature_payload); persisted as binding_signature in checkpoint/digest and thereby transitively in manifest.json
R_schema.signature_serialization: canonical_json_v2 means json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) encoded UTF-8 plus exactly one trailing LF; strict parsing rejects duplicate/non-string keys and non-finite numbers
R_schema.P_expansion_rule: R replaces every argv occurrence of every P_compile_time_slot exactly once. Any remaining argv brace must name a declared runtime_late_slot. OUTPUT_PATH and CHILD_CHECKPOINT_PATH are wrapper-resolved from the actual initial/resume attempt only after history and fencing validation, using R_paths; they cannot be frozen to a0 or supplied by the dispatcher. RUN_BINDINGS_PATH is replaced only by the wrapper with the absolute, read-only path already validated from its --bindings-file argument; its file must be the exact run_bindings_revision blob from the separate bindings checkout and must not be copied into source. For c6.base_plus_s.l1 the wrapper must validate the direct qualification producer, read its base_producer_identity, resolve that exact transitive Base artifact, and replace both BASE_PRODUCER_* slots; the runtime binding signature covers both producer identities. A declared direct producer runtime slot may be wrapper-only for L4 because the unchanged official stress child does not consume L2 evidence; the wrapper must still resolve and validate both direct producer slots before child import. Unknown/missing required slots, duplicate record IDs, non-allowlisted entrypoints or argv differences are invalid.
R_schema.self_identity_rule: R does not contain its own commit/blob/hash. The workflow's run_bindings_revision is the exact checked-out R commit; the checked-out R blob and full-byte hash are verified against D and every sealed envelope. record_signature is static and frozen in R; runtime binding_signature is distinct and binds producer/D/C/resolved item-manifest identity without rewriting R.

attempt_policy.resume_attempt_id_derivation: `r${resume_sequence}-${12_lowercase_hex}` with resume_sequence starting at 1; <=63 chars; a fresh random suffix is required
attempt_policy.resume_workflow_run_id_schema: ^$|^[1-9][0-9]*$ and strictly less than current GITHUB_RUN_ID
attempt_policy.fencing_sequence: numeric GITHUB_RUN_ID; GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT is provenance only and must equal 1
attempt_policy.logical_run_id_binding: Each binding record copies its exact immutable logical_run_id from the corresponding P binding_spec; the seven P values are pairwise unique. The wrapper rejects the workflow input unless it equals that R/P value before history lookup or child import.

child_environment.rule: No other C6_* variable reaches the child. The token is a runner-generated concurrency nonce, not an authentication secret or workflow-dispatch input. It is masked before any later step and may exist only in wrapper/child process environment; raw bytes are forbidden from argv, logs, downloaded/uploaded artifacts, payloads, checkpoints, envelopes and sidecars, where only SHA-256 may persist. C6_BOUND_RESUME_SIGNATURE exists only after the wrapper authenticates a prior diagnostic checkpoint; it binds the old signature while the new attempt writes its fresh signature.

run_templates.output_paths: R derives wrapper-owned normalized paths under artifacts/checkpoints/c6/{logical_run_id}/; no placeholder may select an importable package path. stop_conditions: Any real scenario or backtest economic field is dispatched, enqueued or inspected before P, I_B, I_S and R are all frozen and remotely verified.
Any frozen workflow, dependency, data, scenario, reference, gate, comparator, seed, parallel merge order or account-lock identity drifts.
Warm-state audit finds unauthorized holdings, cash, PnL, peaks, pending orders, locks or future information.
Data audit finds an invalid or universe-dependent old-symbol raw frame or causal indicator.
Base correctness, identity, architecture or no-drift fails.
Any Base residual fails S qualification, or the sole Base+S L1 fails an applicable predicate.
Selected C fails any L2 predicate or any L4 formal gate.
A third candidate, parameter search, threshold change, scenario change, reference change, gate change or second L4 logical run is proposed.
Main tracked tree drifts from the frozen base before economic completion.
Required review or CI has an unresolved Critical or Important result.
Atomic expected-base merge provenance or supported merge-queue equivalent is unavailable at final merge time.

Any ambiguity or incompleteness in the exact schema catalog, R expansion, producer chain, D validation, workflow history enumeration, checkpoint identity or exit classification before first dispatch requires a superseding P before any economic enqueue.

Any native GitHub rerun, missing/expired workflow history, prior matching run without a valid sealed checkpoint/result, duplicate result, or producer-chain mismatch permanently invalidates that logical run.
L4 exit 2 is a valid terminal rejection and stops without resume; it is not checkpoint failure.
Any need to modify the merged workflow/CI preflight, dependency lock, official stress/gate code, data, scenario/reference identity or P/I_B/I_S/R after first economic enqueue stops this experiment.
unknowns_before_implementation: Exact I_B and I_S commit/tree/blob identities are unknown until their reviewed clean trees are frozen; P supplies only exact construction and R schemas.
Exact R commit/blob/full-byte identity is unknown until both implementations and runtime probe values are frozen.
Base residual IDs and S qualification outcome are intentionally unknown until the one bound Base L1 result; they cannot alter S code, formulas or schemas.
D, C and downstream producer artifact hashes are intentionally unknown until mechanical selection; only their exact late-binding schemas are open.
Economic effects, formal acceptance and practical live performance remain unknown; no new C6 economic run has been dispatched or inspected.

field_types.item_manifest_sha256: 64 lowercase hex equal resolved binding item manifest

array_order.completed_item_ids: exact prefix of binding item manifest

tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_REJECTED: status=rejected; Base artifact is valid; s_qualification=null; base_plus_s_l1=null; base_plus_s_l1_predicates=null; selected_candidate=null; C=null; rejection_reasons exactly [BASE_L1_PREDICATE_FAILED]; applies iff any non-deferred Base predicate fails, whether residual_ids is empty or nonempty
tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_SELECTED: status=selected; residual_ids=[] with empty-list SHA-256; every Base predicate passed; s_qualification=null; base_plus_s_l1=null; base_plus_s_l1_predicates=null; selected_candidate=C6-Base; C=I_B; rejection_reasons=[]
tagged_union_by_branch.QUALIFICATION_REJECTED: status=rejected; residual_ids nonempty; every non-deferred Base predicate passed; s_qualification non-null and complete with all_passed=false; base_plus_s_l1=null; base_plus_s_l1_predicates=null; selected_candidate=null; C=null; rejection_reasons exactly [S_QUALIFICATION_FAILED]
tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_PLUS_S_REJECTED: status=rejected; residual_ids nonempty; every non-deferred Base predicate passed; s_qualification non-null complete/all_passed=true; base_plus_s_l1 non-null valid; base_plus_s_l1_predicates non-null with at least one failure; selected_candidate=null; C=null; rejection_reasons exactly [BASE_PLUS_S_L1_PREDICATE_FAILED]
tagged_union_by_branch.BASE_PLUS_S_SELECTED: status=selected; residual_ids nonempty; every non-deferred Base predicate passed; s_qualification non-null complete/all_passed=true; base_plus_s_l1 non-null valid; every Base+S predicate passed; selected_candidate=C6-Base+S; C=I_S; rejection_reasons=[]

D_selection.union_validation: Exactly one branch variant must match every field. Static contract tests must instantiate and accept each of the five branch variants, then reject a missing branch, an unknown branch and every cross-branch field combination. No downstream artifact may be retained after BASE_REJECTED. Invalid Base/Base+S payload, malformed/incomplete qualification, or invalid producer is abnormal and stops without D.

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.abnormal_exit_rule: Any other child/bound-run exit is failure. It may upload a sealed checkpoint only if checkpoint validation completed; it may never be converted to a rejected or passed result.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.l4_exit_2: A valid, sealed, terminal rejected official result; never classified as checkpointed-incomplete and never rerun in this experiment.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.generic_vs_official: The wrapper validates identity/progress and hashes the child checkpoint. L1/QUALIFICATION/L2 child_checkpoint_kind=c6_diagnostic_shard_v2 must satisfy schema_catalog.definitions.diagnostic_child_checkpoint. L4 child_checkpoint_kind=official_stress_v2 must satisfy schema_catalog.definitions.official_stress_child_checkpoint and additionally pass the frozen official stress checkpoint loader/validator byte-for-byte; the wrapper never rewrites or canonicalizes child checkpoint bytes.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.resume_from: Exact SHA-256 of the prior sealed checkpoint_wrapper canonical bytes, never a path or opaque token.

history_query.API: GitHub Actions list workflow runs plus list artifacts, actions:read
history_query.pagination: exhaust every page until no result; failure, truncation, rate-limit ambiguity or inaccessible history is STOP
history_query.current_exclusion: exclude only exact current GITHUB_RUN_ID after validating it has the same workflow/event/head SHA

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.administrative_trust_boundary: The protocol prevents accidental duplicate evaluation and fails closed on every visible run lacking a valid result/checkpoint. It does not claim cryptographic resistance to a repository administrator deleting GitHub Actions run history itself. Manual run/artifact deletion, retention reduction below 90 days, or loss of exhaustive actions:read visibility invalidates the entire C6 experiment; operators must not redispatch any affected logical_run_id. This is an explicit platform trust assumption, not evidence that an absent artifact means no execution.

state_machine.NEW: No prior matching run exists; resume inputs empty.
state_machine.RESUME_ALLOWED: Exactly one latest sealed checkpoint chain exists, no result exists, prior workflow run is terminal/inactive, resume_workflow_run_id equals that run and resume_from equals its wrapper hash.
state_machine.TERMINAL_RESULT: Any valid prior result exists; current run exits before importing or executing economic code.
state_machine.INVALID_HISTORY: Any prior matching run has neither a valid sealed result nor valid sealed checkpoint, has conflicting artifacts, broken predecessor chain, unavailable/expired evidence, or ambiguous pagination; STOP permanently for this logical run.

checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.takeover: A new workflow_dispatch with a new run ID, derived resume attempt ID and new fencing token is required. GitHub rerun is forbidden. Concurrency plus history preflight must complete before the child imports.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.writer_rule: Only the current highest valid GITHUB_RUN_ID fencing sequence may atomically publish into its local attempt path. A stale writer cannot update pointers or seal. Each attempt writes a versioned path and atomically renames only after hashes validate.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.completion_once: Exactly one valid result for a logical_run_id. Discovery of two results is INVALID_HISTORY, not a tie-break.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.checkpoint_progress: completed_item_ids must be an exact prefix of the binding item manifest; resume starts at next_item_ordinal and never recomputes a completed shard.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.platform_rule: If a run cannot continue and cannot atomically seal a valid checkpoint, emit incomplete_no_checkpoint and stop the experiment; do not dispatch a replacement.
checkpoint_and_lease_protocol.budget_rule: After at most checkpoint_every items, persist the exact completed prefix atomically. After 900 monotonic seconds, yield code 75 only at a durable incomplete boundary. Every resumed attempt performs at least one new chunk. The six causal intervention rows are finalized together before checkpoint publication. Official L4 uses its frozen existing sorted checkpoint representation; wrapper verifies it corresponds to the exact execution prefix and never rewrites child bytes.

automatic_resume.trigger: workflow_run completed success, exact v10 workflow anchor only
automatic_resume.dispatch: workflow_dispatch at the frozen workflow ref, exact 16 inputs reconstructed from the prior sealed manifest; next attempt r{sequence}-{first12(wrapper_sha256)}
automatic_resume.no_dispatch: terminal result, already-visible later attempt, invalid identity/hash/progress/deadline, or native rerun; no native economic reruns
automatic_resume.validation_boundary: Privileged trusted orchestration imports no candidate code. Full child schemas, exact manifest prefix, complete predecessor chain and fenced lease takeover are revalidated by the frozen bound runner before economic execution.
